question: Which of the following is NOT a disadvantage of LAN?

options.text: It can face security issues if the central server is not properly secured.
It has high data transmission rates.
It has a high initial setup cost.
It restricts the size of the network.

solution:
The correct answer is __It has high data transmission rates.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A Local Area Network (LAN)__ is a network that connects devices within a limited area such as homes, offices, or schools.
 
• While LANs offer several advantages, they can face security issues if the central server is not properly secured.
 
• Setting up a LAN involves high initial costs due to the need for networking equipment such as routers, switches, and cables.
 
• The size of a LAN is limited and typically confined to a small geographical area.
 
• However, having high data transmission rates is an advantage of LAN and not a disadvantage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Advantages of LAN:**
 
 
• High-speed data transfer within the network due to low latency.
 
• Cost-effective sharing of resources such as printers and internet connections.
 
• Enhanced security within the network perimeter when properly configured.
 
 
 
• **Disadvantages of LAN:**
 
 
• High initial setup costs for network hardware and installation.
 
• Requires ongoing maintenance and administration.
 
• Limited geographical coverage compared to wide-area networks (WANs).
